title: Page 7
content_zh:
稍后，杜天云刚换好衣服，正要系上领带——
“等等，让我来。”她嫣然一笑，取下他脖子上的领带，拿出另外一条全新的领带替他系上。
“这本来是上个星期就要送给你的礼物。为了挑这份礼物给你，人家跑了好几个地方，还特地向专柜小姐学会怎么打领带呢！”她觉得有必要适时的让他知道自己对他的付出，他才能体会到她的用心。
“佳颖……”他清楚地知道这份礼物为何迟了一周才送到，因此看着她若无其事的笑容，更让他觉得惭愧和抱歉，忧心她此时是否又在故作坚强，在他面前强颜欢笑。
“你该不会又要跟我说‘对不起’了吧？”关佳颖先他一步开口，光看丈夫的表情也猜到他要说什么，他的良心不安全写在脸上了。
“……我只是想告诉你这件事错在我，所以你尽管怨我、怪我都没关系，但是不要把痛苦憋在心里，让自己难受。”他咽下被她料中的歉意，却还是开口向她认错，因为除了深疚的歉意之外，他真的无法对她多解释些什么，狡辩关于她所知的事实。
“好，等我觉得难过的时候，一定会骂你出气的。”她立刻答应，表情却轻松愉快，好像跟他说的是完全不同的两件事。
“佳颖，我是认真的。”他强调，觉得她八成在逞强。
“人家也没在跟你开玩笑呀！”她好笑地瞅了他一眼，觉得他好像很想被她骂的样子。
“你真的没事？”他握住她的肩膀，很怀疑地盯着她。
“我会有什么事？难道你比较想看到人家大哭大闹，吵着要跟你离婚吗？”她娇嗔地问他，明眸善睐的眉目间真的读不出半点感伤，也瞧不出丝毫委屈。
一番思考过后，她已决定不再为了无法改变的过去而伤神，只要打起精神、勇往直前，为了与他相守的未来而努力。
他凝望着她梨颊微涡容颜，顿时有种时光倒流的错觉，觉得时间好像无声无息的回到一周前——她不曾受到打击，也从没失望落泪，眼中依旧潺流着对他的情意，仿佛什么事都没有发生过……
“佳颖，你……不后悔跟我结婚？”杜天云忍不住问道。原本以为她知道真相后会对他的为人感到寒心，或许也对这桩婚姻萌生悔意，但碍于两家的社会地位不能轻言离婚，只好逼不得已地回到他身边……
最坏的可能他都想过，就是没想到她会一如往常地和他谈笑风生。
“等我后悔了，自然会通知你。”她替他别上同样经过精心挑选的领带夹，将他转向镜子——
“好了，我的眼光不错吧。”她欣欣得意地说，对自己的成果感到十分满意。
“谢谢你。”他凝视镜中的倩影，心头漾起一股因她而生的感动，使他不得不察觉这女孩在他心中的分量早已超出他所预设的比重，承载着更深的情感……
他微笑，真的很庆幸自己能遇到这个女孩，娶到这么可爱、善良的她。
“不客气，快出来吃早餐。”她帮他把原来的领带收回原位，转身——

蓦地，他的大脑又接收到来自视觉神经的刺激，因为那婀娜多姿的背影而产生几秒的失神……
这个早晨，他的脑袋可说是异常清醒，又不时处于空白状态，以至于连一顿早餐都吃得比平常久，约莫晚了半个多小时，他才走出家门准备上班。
“天云，你是不是忘了什么？”关佳颖揪着围裙，以软软的声音提醒他。
才隔了一个星期而已，他不会这么快就忘了每天分开前都要先吻她一下吧。
杜天云轻笑，并没有忘记这些小动作，不过被她用那种撒娇的语调提醒，倒也觉得舒服的。
他低头，在她的脸颊上亲了一下。
“还有。”她偏过头——因为当老公亲吻你左脸的时候，别忘了要把右脸也凑上去让他亲一下。
看出来她在撒娇，杜天云倒也很配合地吻了一下她的右脸颊。
“这里。”她吐吐舌头，又指着自己的额头。
她的表情如此可爱，他当然不忍拒绝地亲了一下她指定的地方。
“嘻——最后一个。”她开心地嘻笑，又指着自己的鼻尖，向他索吻。
他瞧她好像玩上瘾了，像个不想结束游戏的小孩，不过他自己也有点乐在其中，不想扫她的兴，于是再吻她的鼻尖——
她突然仰起脸，让他的吻落在她的唇上，并且勾住他的后颈，延长两唇相依的时间。
他惊愣！却也在讶异的瞬间臣服于唇上的柔软，唤起曾经深吻过那双唇的甜美记忆——
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
她顾不得害羞，完全凭着自己的感觉吻他，出门前就想好今天一定要实现想像已久的画面，和他来个深情的吻别……
她的主动让他感到吃惊，但也兴奋莫名。他叹息似地张口，却乘机含住她调皮的舌，夺走唇间的主导权，探入她的口中，加深这个粗浅的吻，品尝那令人回味无穷的甜美滋味。
“唔……”他热切的索取，一下子便把她吻得头发昏、脚发软，身子无力地贴向他。
他察觉到她的虚软，欲出手支撑她的重量，然而双手却在贴上她的俏臀后不自觉地停留，再没离开过那圆润的曲线……
她没空留意，也不在乎他的手摆在哪里，只是忘情地承受他灼人的气息、炽热的吻，两人都头不得空气愈来愈稀薄，在急促的喘息间激情拥吻，紧紧纠缠……

第8章(2)
忽然，对面的大门被推开——
“哇！大清早就在大门口吻得难分难舍，果真是小别胜新婚呐。”杜天海吹了一声响亮的口哨，调侃眼前这火辣辣的一幕。
缠绵的两人立刻分开，脸上各自写着尴尬和难为情，尤其是关佳颖的脸根本像煮熟的虾子，红上加红……
“难得看你这么早出门。”杜天云率先回复镇定，将妻子揽到身后，替她挡住度天海看好戏的视线，以及她背部的曼妙曲线，不想让任何男人看见她诱人的美，即使是他“阅女无数”的弟弟也不例外。
“是你晚了吧？”度天海撇唇一笑。看惯了身边身材惹火、打扮性感的女人，他并没有将这个邻家女孩的衣着放在眼里，倒是撞见一向冷静自持的老哥居然在自家门口和老婆吻得浑然忘我，觉得十分惊奇有趣。
“小妹妹，看不出来你这么热情耶。”见大哥护妻心切，杜天海就更想要捉弄人，故意伸长脖子对关佳颖“放话”。
杜天云拧眉睨着他，看穿弟弟恶作剧的细胞又在蠢蠢欲动，于是转头要关佳颖先进屋去，免得待会儿被人惹毛，气坏身子。
然而她一听见杜天海那种嘲讽的语气，加上之前说要帮她丈夫介绍女朋友，叫她想离婚就快点把手续办一办，真是旧恨加新仇，觉得肚子里一把火……
“怎么样，我在我家门口亲我老公不行吗？”她自认光明正大地勾着老公的手，不甘示弱地挺身回呛。
“可以，请便。”见她被激怒，杜天海更是玩心大起，愈想逗着她玩。“哥，要不要我顺便帮你请半天假？还是一天比较充裕？至于这位小妹妹——”
“不要叫我小妹妹，以后你……都要叫我“大嫂”！”她一手插腰，郑重地声明。
“什么！大嫂？”杜氏兄弟同时愣住，都看向她。
“天云是你哥，我是他老婆。当然就是你的大嫂喽。”她说明这理所当然的关系，觉得自己好聪明唷！居然能临时想到这个反制他的好方法。
content_en:
Later, Du Tianyun had just changed his clothes and was about to put on his tie——
"Wait, let me do it." She smiled sweetly, took off the tie around his neck, and took out another brand-new tie to tie it for him.
"This was originally a gift I was going to give you last week. In order to choose this gift for you, I went to several places, and even learned how to tie a tie from the counter lady!" She felt that it was necessary to let him know her dedication to him in a timely manner, so that he could appreciate her intentions.
"Jiaying..." He knew clearly why the gift was delivered a week late, so looking at her nonchalant smile made him feel even more ashamed and sorry. He was worried whether she was pretending to be strong again and forcing a smile in front of him.
"You're not going to say 'I'm sorry' to me again, are you?" Guan Jiaying spoke before him. Just by looking at her husband's expression, she could guess what he was going to say. His uneasy conscience was written on his face.
"...I just want to tell you that this is my fault, so it doesn't matter if you blame me or blame me, but don't keep the pain in your heart and make yourself uncomfortable." He swallowed the apology that she expected, but still opened his mouth to admit his mistake to her, because other than a deep apology, he really couldn't explain anything more to her and quibble about the facts she knew.
"Okay, when I feel sad, I will definitely scold you to vent my anger." She agreed immediately, but her expression was relaxed and happy, as if she was telling him two completely different things.
"Jia Ying, I'm serious." He emphasized, feeling that she was probably trying to show off her strength.
"I'm not kidding you!" She gave him a funny look, feeling that he seemed to want to be scolded by her.
"Are you really okay?" He held her shoulders and stared at her suspiciously.
"What will happen to me? Do you prefer to see people crying and making noises, clamoring to divorce you?" She asked him coquettishly. There was really no trace of sadness or grievance in her bright eyes.
After some thought, she decided not to worry about the unchangeable past, but to cheer up, move forward bravely, and work hard for a future with him.
He stared at her pear-cheeked face, and suddenly had the illusion of going back in time, as if time had returned silently to a week ago - she had never been hit, nor was she disappointed and shed tears, and her eyes were still full of love for him, as if nothing had happened...
"Jiaying, you... don't regret marrying me?" Du Tianyun couldn't help but ask. She originally thought that after knowing the truth, she would feel chilled by his behavior, and perhaps regret the marriage, but due to the social status of the two families, she could not divorce easily, so she had no choice but to return to him...
He might have thought about the worst, but he didn't expect that she would chat and laugh with him as usual.
"When I regret it, I will let you know naturally." She pinned on the tie clip that was also carefully selected for him, and turned him to the mirror——
"Okay, I have a good eye." She said happily, very satisfied with her results.
"Thank you." He stared at the beautiful figure in the mirror, and his heart was moved by her. He had to realize that the weight of this girl in his heart had already exceeded the proportion he had preset, and she carried deeper emotions...
He smiled, feeling really lucky that he could meet this girl and marry such a lovely and kind-hearted woman.
"You're welcome, come out for breakfast." She helped him put the original tie back into place and turned around——
Suddenly, his brain received another stimulation from the optic nerve, and he lost consciousness for a few seconds because of that graceful back...
This morning, his mind was extremely clear and blank from time to time, so that even breakfast took longer than usual. He walked out of the house about half an hour later and got ready to go to work.
"Tianyun, have you forgotten something?" Guan Jiaying grabbedApron, reminded him in a soft voice.
It's only been a week, he wouldn't forget to kiss her every day before leaving so quickly.
Du Tianyun chuckled, not forgetting these little moves, but he felt comfortable being reminded by her coquettish tone.
He lowered his head and kissed her on the cheek.
"Also." She tilted her head - because when your husband kisses your left cheek, don't forget to bring your right cheek up for him to kiss.
Seeing that she was acting coquettishly, Du Tianyun cooperated and kissed her right cheek.
"Here." She stuck out her tongue and pointed to her forehead.
Her expression was so cute, and of course he couldn't bear to refuse and kissed her at the designated spot.
"Hee - the last one." She laughed happily, pointed to the tip of her nose, and asked him for a kiss.
He looked at her as if she was addicted to playing, like a child who didn't want to end the game, but he was also enjoying it a little and didn't want to spoil her fun, so he kissed the tip of her nose again——
She suddenly raised her face, letting his kiss fall on her lips, and hooked the back of his neck, prolonging the time their lips were together.
He was stunned! But in a moment of surprise, she surrendered to the softness of her lips, evoking the sweet memory of those lips she once deeply kissed——
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
She ignored her shyness and kissed him based on her own feelings. Before going out, she decided that today she would realize the scene she had imagined for a long time and kiss him affectionately goodbye...
He was surprised by her initiative, but also excited. He opened his mouth like a sigh, but took the opportunity to hold her naughty tongue in his mouth, taking away the dominance of her lips, and penetrated her mouth, deepening the rough kiss and tasting the endlessly sweet taste.
"Hmm..." He asked eagerly, kissing her until her head was dizzy, her feet were weak, and her body was weakly pressed against him.
He noticed her weakness and wanted to use his hands to support her weight, but his hands unconsciously stayed on her pretty buttocks and never left the round curves...
She had no time to pay attention and didn't care where his hands were. She just endured his burning breath and passionate kiss without any emotion. Both of them were head-shaking as the air became thinner and thinner. They kissed passionately and entangled tightly while breathing rapidly...
Chapter 8(2)
Suddenly, the door on the opposite side was pushed open——
"Wow! We kissed hard at the gate so early in the morning. It's really better to say goodbye than a wedding." Du Tianhai blew a loud whistle, teasing the hot scene in front of him.
The two people who were entangled in each other immediately separated, with embarrassment and embarrassment written on their faces, especially Guan Jiaying's face, which looked like a cooked shrimp, redder than redder...
"It's rare to see you go out so early." Du Tianyun was the first to regain his composure, and held his wife behind him, blocking Du Tianhai's view of the show and the graceful curves of her back. He didn't want any man to see her seductive beauty, even his younger brother who "had seen countless women" was no exception.
"Are you too late?" Du Tianhai curled his lips and smiled. He was used to seeing women with hot bodies and sexy dresses around him, so he didn't take the girl next door's clothes seriously. Instead, he was surprised and amused when he saw the always calm and self-controlled man actually kissing his wife completely at the door of his house.
"Little sister, I can't tell you are so enthusiastic." Seeing that his eldest brother was eager to protect his wife, Du Tianhai wanted to tease people even more, and deliberately stretched his neck to "talk" to Guan Jiaying.
Du Tianyun frowned and stared at him, seeing through his brother's mischievous cells that were about to start again, so he turned around and asked Guan Jiaying to go into the room first, so as not to be pissed off later and get angry.
However, as soon as she heard Du Tianhai's sarcastic tone, coupled with the previous statement that he would help her husband introduce a girlfriend, and told her to hurry up and complete the formalities if she wanted a divorce, it was really old hatred and new hatred, and she felt a fire in her stomach...
"How about it, can't I kiss my husband in front of my house?" she thought to herselfShe held her husband's hand openly and stood up to choke him back.
"Okay, please." Seeing that she was irritated, Du Tianhai became more playful and wanted to tease her even more. "Brother, do you want me to take half a day off for you? Or is one day more sufficient? As for this little sister -"
"Don't call me little sister. From now on... you will all call me 'sister-in-law'!" She put her hands on her waist and declared solemnly.
"What! Sister-in-law?" The Du brothers were stunned at the same time and looked at her.
"Tianyun is your brother and I am his wife. Of course I am your sister-in-law." She explained this natural relationship and felt that she was so smart! He could actually think of this good way to counter him on the spur of the moment.
